Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all . 
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
The Data Analyst supports Global Procurement by enabling trusted, standardized, and AI ‑ ready procurement data that drives productivity, business value, and transformation outcomes. This role plays a hands ‑ on, execution ‑ focused part in operationalizing data governance, improving master data quality, and enabling consistent KPI and program reporting across GP.
The analyst connects day ‑ to ‑ day data governance and stewardship activities to measurable procurement outcomes , reducing manual effort, improving decision quality, and accelerating adoption of analytics, automation, and AI capabilities.
This is not an IT or Business Intelligence role. The analyst partners closely with GP business teams, Master Data, Analytics, AI, and IT functions to align with enterprise data standards, controls, and approved platforms. 
GP KPIs, Metrics & Program Reporting 
Support GP KPI frameworks by ensuring metric definitions, data sources, and calculations are clearly defined, standardized, and auditable. 
Enable consistent, trusted program and transformation reporting by improving data reliability and transparency. 
Partner with GP program owners to align reporting needs with governed data sources and approved definitions.
Data Governance & Quality Operations 
Execute day-to-day procurement data governance activities, including stewardship support, data quality monitoring, issue intake, and remediation tracking. 
Support the procurement data stewardship operating model, including routines, escalation paths, and documentation. 
Define and maintain governance artifacts such as business glossaries, critical data elements, and business rules for key procurement datasets. 
Track and report data quality KPIs (e.g., completeness, accuracy, duplication, timeliness) and support root cause analysis with data and process owners.
Procurement Master Data Management 
Perform hands-on procurement master data clean up and standardization activities (supplier, category, material, contract, and reference data). 
Coordinate with Master Data and process owners to resolve data quality issues at the source and prevent recurrence. 
Support continuous improvement of master data processes and controls.
AI R eady Procurement Data Enablement 
Contribute to procurement master data strategy required to enable AI, automation, and advanced analytics use cases. 
Partner with analytics and AI teams to translate use case requirements into actionable data governance and data quality improvements. 
E nsure procurement data is structured, labeled, and governed to be AI ready , with clear ownership, definitions, and quality thresholds .
Cross Functional Collaboration 
Act as a liaison between GP business teams, Analytics, AI, Master Data, and IT for data related topics. 
Support alignment between procurement specific needs and enterprise data governance standards.
Qualifications 
Education 
Bachelor's degree in computer science , Information Systems, Data Analytics, or related field required . 
Advanced degree or certification in data management, analytics, or governance is a plus. 
Practical experience with cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake) is required .
Experience 
Min 3– 4 years of experience in data quality, analytics, or reporting roles. 
Hands‑on experience with master data management and data quality operations, preferably in Procurement or Supply Chain domains. 
Basic knowledge of any Business Intell igence tools for Reporting such as Tableau/ Power BI is a plus 
Experience supporting KPI frameworks, metrics definition, and program reporting. 
Exposure to AI, advanced analytics, or data readiness initiatives is strongly preferred. 
Skills & Attributes 
Strong analytical mindset with high attention to detail and data accuracy. 
Working knowledge of data governance concepts including stewardship, ownership, critical data elements, and quality metrics. 
Ability to translate business questions into clear data definitions and measurable metrics. 
Comfortable working cross ‑ functionally and influencing without direct authority. 
Clear communicator with the ability to document standards, definitions, and processes. 
Understanding how data quality and standardization enable automation, analytics, and AI outcomes. 
What Success Looks Like 
Trusted and reliable procurement data and KPIs used for decision ‑ making and program reviews. 
Data quality issues are visible, prioritized, and systematically reduced over time. 
Procurement master data is standardized and governed, reducing manual effort and reporting friction. 
Data governance and master data improvements demonstrably increase GP productivity and accelerate AI and automation adoption.

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

The responsibilities of our Platform team include building and maintaining all backend services, including, but not limited to, payments, analytics, subscriptions, new products, text to speech, and external APIs.

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, is passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week.

What You’ll Do

Design, develop, and maintain robust APIs including public TTS API, internal APIs like Payment, Subscription, Auth and Consumption Tracking, ensuring they meet business and scalability requirements
Oversee the full backend API landscape, enhancing and optimizing for performance and maintainability
Collaborate on B2B solutions, focusing on customization and integration needs for enterprise clients
Work closely with cross-functional teams to align backend architecture with overall product strategy and user experience

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

Proven experience in backend development: TS/Node (required)
Direct experience with GCP and knowledge of AWS, Azure, or other cloud providers
Efficiency in ideation and implementation, prioritizing tasks based on urgency and impact
Preferred: Experience with Docker and containerized deployments
Preferred: Proficiency in deploying high availability applications on Kubernetes

A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products
A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive
Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity
The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry
Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture
The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more
An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain

Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
Client: Threads Uniform Agency
Location: Any Madhya Pradesh (MP) Location (Remote / Offshore)

## About Threads Uniform Agency & The Role
Threads Uniform Agency is seeking a Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer for a critical, end-to-end cloud modernization engagement.
In this role, you will lead the migration of our legacy, single-server e-commerce stack into a modern, secure, and PCI-compliant Azure environment. The current setup runs NopCommerce, SQL Server, IIS, and SFTP bundled on a single legacy AWS EC2 instance. You will be responsible for unbundling this monolith into highly available, separated compute, database, and file-transfer tiers.
Threads Uniform Agency already has a sketched target architecture in place. You will not be starting from a blank page; instead, you will validate, refine, and execute this vision. This is a high-ownership, independent role covering infrastructure architecture, hands-on Azure provisioning, and building critical data pipelines from our on-premises SQL layer (fed by a SaaS ERP) into a cloud data lake. You will work closely with our client-side IT Director and a separate offshore vendor handling the parallel e-commerce platform upgrade.
## Key Responsibilities
Architecture & Azure Provisioning: Validate and refine the sketched target architecture; hands-on provisioning of VNets, Azure SQL, Blob Storage, Key Vault, and IAM/RBAC using Infrastructure-as-Code.
Monolith Unbundling: Deconstruct the existing single-server setup into dedicated, secure, and scalable cloud tiers.
Data Pipeline Engineering: Build robust batch ETL pipelines (full + incremental loads) using Azure Data Factory to move data from SQL Server sources into a cloud data lake.
Security & PCI Compliance: Establish and document a PCI DSS-compliant baseline, ensuring robust network segmentation, access controls, and strict encryption at rest and in transit.
Integration Mapping: Map and validate integration points with third-party SaaS solutions (ERP-as-SaaS, tax services, payment processors, and EDI/punch-out connectors).
Documentation: Maintain strict documentation discipline, delivering Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), operational runbooks, and a phased migration roadmap.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Act as an independent expert, reviewing third-party vendor proposals and translating technical tradeoffs clearly during weekly syncs with the IT Director.
## Required Skills & Qualifications
Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure core services (VNet, Azure SQL, Blob Storage, Azure Monitor, Key Vault, IAM/RBAC).
Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Proven expertise using Terraform or ARM/Bicep.
Data Integration: Solid experience with Azure Data Factory (or equivalent ETL/orchestration tools) building pipelines from SQL Server.
Database Expertise: Strong SQL Server background with the ability to reverse-engineer and document existing schemas.
Scripting: Proficiency in Python, PowerShell, or Bash to migrate and adapt legacy automation workflows.
Compliance: Direct exposure to PCI DSS requirements and compliance documentation.
Independence: Proven track record of working successfully as a solo engineer on a project without a secondary backup resource.

Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,400 firms in nearly 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $9 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with nearly 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, London, Edinburgh, Pune, Dubai, Geneva and São Paulo.

The Role

We are currently seeking a Software Engineer, Fullstack to join the AI Platform team, which powers intelligent experiences across our AI products.

As a Fullstack Engineer, you'll build and ship features across both the backend services and frontend interface of the AI Platform — spanning Python FastAPI/Flask microservices, AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, Redis, WebSocket streaming, and a Svelte-based real-time chat UI. You'll work across the full stack to deliver features for Addison, Addepar's AI-powered assistant. Current capabilities include conversational portfolio analysis, specialized agents for data operations and reporting workflows, dynamic chart generation, and real-time streaming interactions — with new agent capabilities and integrations shipping regularly.

Day to day, you'll be writing backend services, building streaming UIs, and connecting the two — delivering complete features in a team where AI products move fast and your work reaches users directly.

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

What You’ll Do

Build and maintain backend services that power AI Platform products, developing in Python or other modern backend languages with emphasis on reliability and maintainability. 
Build and evolve REST APIs — including request validation, error handling, and clear API contracts between frontend and backend. 
Work with relational and/or NoSQL data models across systems such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, and Redis. 
Build and maintain asynchronous processing flows using queues and worker-based systems.
Build real-time UI features for conversational interfaces — including chat streaming, incremental rendering, and dynamic layouts. 
Work with WebSocket pipelines to handle streamed data, retries, and reconnection gracefully. 
Implement state management for streaming UIs, handling partial data, scroll behavior, and UI correctness over time. 
Deliver features end-to-end — owning both backend logic and the frontend implementation that consumes it. 
Write strong automated tests, including unit and integration coverage across both backend (pytest) and frontend (Vitest, Playwright), and contribute to CI-based quality gates.
Debug production issues across service and UI boundaries using logs, metrics, browser DevTools, and system reasoning.
Contribute to code reviews, system quality, and engineering standards across the team. 
Grow your skills in your secondary stack with support from senior engineers and through hands-on feature delivery. 

Who You Are

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
At least three years of professional fullstack development experience in a production environment.
Strong in one area (backend or frontend) with demonstrable, production-level depth — not surface-level familiarity.
Evident experience in the other area — has shipped real features (not just tutorials or side projects) on the complementary side of the stack, with clear desire to grow there.
Proficiency in at least one production backend language such as Python, Go, Java, or C++, and the ability to work across a polyglot environment. 
Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript and a modern UI framework (Svelte preferred; React, Angular, or Vue acceptable). 
Solid software engineering fundamentals — debugging, code quality, testing, and operational awareness. 
Experience building and maintaining REST APIs in a production context. 
Experience with relational databases and/or NoSQL data stores in production systems. 
Understanding of asynchronous processing patterns such as queues, workers, and retry/failure handling. 
Proficiency with Docker and familiarity with modern development workflows. 
Strong testing discipline — unit tests, integration tests, and CI pipelines across backend and/or frontend. 
Experience building or operating services on cloud infrastructure in a production context. 
Comfort with browser DevTools for debugging UI issues, understanding async behavior, and basic performance awareness. 
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams. 
Growth mindset — eager to deepen skills on your less-experienced side of the stack through real feature delivery.

Our Values 

Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 
Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success. 
Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 
Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

Identify slow-moving, obsolete, or dead stock (SLOB) and collaborate with commercial teams to create clearance strategies.

3. Data Analytics & Reporting
Maintain accurate inventory databases and generate weekly/monthly inventory health dashboards.
Perform root-cause analysis on inventory discrepancies (e.g., phantom inventory, systemic errors).
Utilize Excel and ERP tools to forecast inventory capital requirements.
Qualifications & Skills
Experience & Education
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Statistics, or a related field.
Experience: 1 to 2 years of hands-on experience in inventory management, data analytics, or supply chain, ideally within a Retail or FMCG environment.
Technical Skills
Advanced Excel: Deep comfort with VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, SUMIFS, and data cleaning formulas.
ERP/WMS Systems: Exposure to inventory modules in ERPs
Soft Skills & Core Competencies
Analytical Mindset: A natural tendency to look at a spreadsheet and find the "story" behind the numbers.

Job Description:

Datavail is seeking a highly skilled Data Governance Analyst to aid in working with our clients to define and develop Data Governance solutions that meet defined business objectives. The individual should have experience in defining and developing solutions around Governance and Data Governance to help define and identify solutions for our client's business problems. The Data Governance Analyst will be responsible for conceptualizing and defining end to end solutions in areas around the use and implementation of Data Governance frameworks and concepts including areas such as Metadata Management, Data Access and Security Governance, Data Stewardship and Operating models, Data Quality Idenification, Root Cause Analysis and Solutioning, and other related areas. 
Key skills include: 
Data Governance Frameworks: 
Deep understanding of DAMA_DMBoK, DCAM, and ISO/IEC 38505. 
Have experience in creating and implementing policies, standards, and controls for enterprise data. 
Metadata Management 
Proficient in Business, technical, and operational metadata. 
Experience with glossaries, catalogs, lineage, and stewardship models including Sensitive data classification and handling. 
Data Access & Security Governance: 
Understands and can define Role_based access control (RBAC) and attribute-based access control (ABAC). 
Regulatory Compliance & Risk: 

Knows regulatory compliance such as GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, HIPAA, SOX, PCI, and emerging AI/data regulations and is able to apply to policies, monitoring, risk assessment and scoring. 
Has experience in conducting data risk assessments and remediation planning. 
Data Stewardship & Operating Models 
Designing centralized, federated, or hybrid governance models. 
Enabling stewardship roles and workflows, being able to align data governance practices to business value and developing use cases for deployment of governance processes including defining data ownership and identifying data owners as well as data stewardship and data stewards. 
Has experience in establishing steering committees, RACI matrix for governance and cadence for on-going governance program. 
AI Governance Literacy & Competency 
AI Risk & Compliance 
Understanding of emerging regulatory frameworks (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF). 
Ability to assess AI/ML models for fairness, bias, transparency, and safety. 
Responsible AI Principles 
Knowledge of ethical AI frameworks, transparency requirements, and accountability structures. 
Creating policy guardrails for model development and deployment. 
Reporting to the Practice Lead, Data Governance, you will partner with our sales, marketing, solution development, Data Management Practice Teams and service delivery management teams to ensure successful pursuit of managed and professional services deals. You will proactively engage with all internal teams to ensure timely delivery of appropriate solutions to customers and drive deal closure. You will be able to collaborate with your peers to continually improve our standards, processes, and pricing for solution development. 
The skills you should bring to the table include over 5 to 10 years of experience in building, managing, and architecting Data Governance solutions in the areas of business intelligence, data management and Data Warehouse solutions. The individual should have a background in multiple areas of Governance solutions and have familiarity with Data Governance tools such as Purview, Collibra, Alation and others (not necessary to have all but some familiarity with a number of these tools), experience with data management disciplines such as Master Data Management, Data Governance, Meta-data management, etc. (not necessary to have all but exposure to multiple is a big plus). Candidates should have played a lead role in the solutioning, design, and implementation of these solutions and acted in a project leadership role in these engagements. Good Communication skills are required as well as experience leading engagements. Experience in performing assessments and defining Analytics solutions is also required.

About the role:
We are looking for a seasoned Machine Learning Engineer with deep expertise in deep learning to design and build production-grade models in the speech/audio and computer vision domains. The Machine Learning Engineer will own the end-to-end model development lifecycle - from dataset curation and architecture design through training, optimization, and deployment, and will work closely with software and product teams to ship low-latency, scalable AI features.

What you will be expected to do

Research, design, train, and productionize deep learning models for speech/audio (ASR, speaker diarization, audio classification, TTS, noise suppression) and computer vision (detection, segmentation, classification, video understanding) use cases.
Architect training pipelines capable of handling large-scale datasets, manage data preprocessing, augmentation, and versioning workflows.
Select and adapt state-of-the-art architectures (Transformers, CNNs, RNNs, diffusion models, etc.) and fine-tune or distill pre-trained models for production constraints.
Optimize models for inference - quantization, pruning, knowledge distillation - targeting latency, throughput, and memory budgets on CPU/GPU/edge hardware.
Work with software engineers to integrate models into production systems, design APIs and microservices for model serving.
Define and track evaluation benchmarks, monitor model performance in production, and drive continuous improvement cycles.
Stay current with research literature, evaluate and implement relevant SOTA techniques, contribute to internal technical forums.

You might be a strong candidate if you have/are

B.Tech / M.Tech / M.Sc. / PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Signal Processing, or a related field.
4+ years of experience in machine learning/deep learning engineering with significant hands-on work in speech/audio and/or computer vision in production environments.
PyTorch (primary) and TensorFlow/Keras, familiarity with JAX is a plus.
Deep expertise in Wav2Vec 2.0, Whisper, ESPnet, SpeechBrain, torchaudio, librosa.
Strong experience with speech/audio frameworks and toolkits: YOLO, DETR, ViT, EfficientNet, SAM, and standard CV pipelines (OpenCV, torchvision, Albumentations).
Solid background in computer vision: TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, TorchScript, DeepSpeed, or Triton Inference Server.
Hands-on experience with model inference optimization using Python and strong software engineering fundamentals: OOP, clean code, testing, CI/CD.
Proficient in SQL for data extraction and pipeline logging.
Experience with distributed training frameworks (DDP, DeepSpeed, FSDP) and large-scale data pipelines.
Familiarity with cloud ML platforms (AWS SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI, Azure ML) and containerized deployment (Docker, Kubernetes, ECS).
Good knowledge of system design principles for ML services: throughput, latency, scalability, fault tolerance.

What Sun King offers

Professional growth in a dynamic, rapidly expanding, high-social-impact industry
An open-minded, collaborative culture made up of enthusiastic colleagues who are driven by the challenge of innovation towards profound impact on people and the planet.
A truly multicultural experience: You will have the chance to work with and learn from people from different geographies, nationalities, and backgrounds.
Structured, tailored learning and development programs that help you become a better leader, manager, and professional through the Sun King Center for Leadership.

About Sun King
Sun King is the world’s leading off-grid solar energy company, combining cutting-edge product design, fintech, and field operations to deliver energy access for the 1.8 billion people who live without an affordable and reliable electric-grid connection.

Sun King has built a new kind of energy utility: distributed, green, customer-centric, and affordable. We bring clean, reliable, decentralized energy directly into people’s lives — from solar kits that provide first-time energy access to multi-kilowatt systems that serve both off-grid users and grid-connected customers powering larger homes, schools, hospitals, farms, offices, and light manufacturing.
Already, 25 million homes and businesses rely on Sun King for electricity supply and the appliances and services it enables: lighting, televisions, fans, refrigeration, and smartphones.

Sun King combines energy generation, energy-efficient appliances, installation, and financing into one seamless offering. Think of it as a distributed utility, designed for wherever energy is needed and designed to scale with its users as incomes and energy needs grow.

Sun King makes solar products affordable to low-income households and businesses via ‘pay-as-you-go’ (PAYG) purchase financing. Sun King installs solar after customers pay a small deposit. Customers then make small, manageable payments of as little as US $0.14 a day via mobile money or cash.
Instead of paying for expensive, polluting, and health-damaging kerosene for lighting or diesel for power, customers unlock savings through accessing solar power and after one to two years of payments, customers own their solar equipment outright.

Sun King collects payments digitally through mobile money systems and its 35,000 field agents — over 1 million payments each day. To date, Sun King has extended more than $1.4 billion in PAYG loans to customers.

Sun King began by powering homes and businesses with solar systems delivered through PAYG financing. Now, we’re using the same model to make smartphones and clean cooking equipment affordable: helping households connect to the digital economy and transition from wood-based fuels to modern, sustainable alternatives.

Sun King employs 3,500 full-time staff in 14 countries, with specialties spanning product design, data science, logistics, customer service, sales, software, operations, and more — all with a passion to serve off-grid families. Sun King is committed to gender diversity in the workplace. Women represent 42% of Sun King’s workforce.

Product intro:
Reflect is SmartBear's AI-powered, no-code test automation platform for creating, maintaining, and running tests across web, API, and mobile applications. Go to our product page if you want to know more about SmartBear Reflect.

As a Software Engineer (Frontend), you will play a key role in developing high-performance, responsive, and secure product experiences using Vue 3, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and modern frontend tooling. Use modern frontend build and development tools such as Webpack, npm, TypeScript configuration, ESLint, Prettier, and Storybook
Follow Agile development practices, participate in sprint ceremonies, code reviews, and continuous improvement discussions

4-6 years of hands-on experience in frontend development, preferably building SaaS or complex product applications
Strong understanding of TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, browser rendering behavior, and responsive UI development
Hands-on experience with Vue.js/Vue 3 or a similar component-based framework, Vue 3 experience is preferred
Familiarity with frontend state management and routing patterns such as Pinia, Vuex, and Vue Router
API-driven development experience working with REST APIs, JSON payloads, WebSocket updates, and asynchronous data flows
Experience with frontend build tooling such as Webpack, npm, TypeScript, Babel, and related configuration
Familiarity with testing frameworks and tools such as Jest, Vue Test Utils, jsdom, Playwright, or Puppeteer

Experience with version control and collaborative development workflows using GitHub or GitLab

Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills
Ability to write clean, modular, testable, and maintainable code

DESCRIPTION
Senior Product Manager – Finance Operations (Employee Expense & Corporate Cards)

Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated and strategic Senior Product Manager to lead the Employee Expense and Corporate Cards product portfolio within Finance Operations. This role presents a unique opportunity to define and build the next generation of AI/ML-powered, enterprise-scale financial products that simplify expense management, enhance user experience, strengthen controllership, and deliver meaningful operational cost savings.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will own the product strategy, roadmap, execution, adoption, and success metrics for solutions supporting employee expenses and corporate card programs. You will partner with leading global card providers, internal business teams, and technology organizations to build innovative products that operate at Amazon scale.

The ideal candidate combines strong product management fundamentals with deep customer obsession, analytical rigor, and the ability to influence across a complex stakeholder ecosystem. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, thinking strategically while maintaining operational excellence, and leveraging emerging AI technologies to solve challenging business problems.

This role requires close collaboration with engineering, data science, analytics, design, finance, operations, and external partners to create scalable solutions that improve customer experiences while maintaining strong financial controls and compliance standards.

Key Responsibilities

Product Vision, Strategy & Roadmap

Define and drive the long-term vision, strategy, and roadmap for Employee Expense and Corporate Cards products.
Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, improve customer experience, enhance financial controls, and reduce operational costs through automation and AI-driven solutions.
Evaluate industry trends, customer feedback, business needs, and operational challenges to uncover high-impact product opportunities.
Develop product tenets, strategic goals, business cases, and investment proposals to support long-term product direction.
Create and maintain multi-year product roadmaps aligned with organizational objectives and business priorities.

Product Discovery & Innovation

Partner with customers, operations teams, finance stakeholders, and leadership teams to identify pain points and unmet needs.
Leverage customer insights, operational data, and market intelligence to prioritize product investments.
Drive innovation through AI/ML-powered capabilities that improve efficiency, decision-making, compliance monitoring, and user experience.
Translate complex business problems into scalable product solutions with measurable outcomes.

Product Planning & Requirements Management

Author compelling PRFAQs, business requirement documents (BRDs), product requirement documents (PRDs), strategy documents, and executive review materials.
Define clear product requirements, user journeys, workflows, and success criteria.
Lead cross-functional planning sessions and facilitate alignment across business and technical stakeholders.
Ensure product decisions are grounded in customer needs, business objectives, and technical feasibility.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Collaborate closely with Software Development Engineers (SDEs), Data Scientists (DSs), Data Engineers (DEs), Business Intelligence Engineers (BIEs), Business Analysts (BAs), UX Designers (UXDs), Program Managers, Finance teams, and Operations leaders.
Lead discussions and decision-making forums with senior executives and stakeholders.
Manage relationships with both first-party (internal) and third-party (external) partners, including global card issuers, payment providers, and technology vendors.
Drive alignment among stakeholders with competing priorities while maintaining focus on customer and business outcomes.

Product Development & Execution

Partner with engineering teams throughout product design, development, testing, and deployment.
Evaluate trade-offs between customer value, business impact, technical complexity, effort, and delivery timelines.
Support technical teams during scoping, architecture discussions, design reviews, and implementation planning.
Ensure products are delivered with high quality, scalability, reliability, and operational excellence.

Metrics, Analytics & Business Performance

Define key input and output metrics to measure product success and business impact.
Establish KPI frameworks, audit mechanisms, reporting standards, evaluation methodologies, and self-inspection processes.
Partner with BIEs, BAs, and DEs to build scalable reporting solutions and performance dashboards.
Continuously monitor product performance and identify opportunities for optimization and improvement.
Present business performance insights and recommendations to leadership teams.

Product Launch & Operational Readiness

Own end-to-end launch planning and execution for new product features and capabilities.
Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT), Pilot Validation Testing (PVT), launch readiness reviews, and rollout planning activities.
Coordinate cross-functional launch activities across product, engineering, operations, finance, and external partners.
Ensure smooth deployment, operational readiness, risk mitigation, and post-launch monitoring.

Adoption, Change Management & Customer Engagement

Develop and execute product socialization, communication, and adoption strategies.
Drive customer onboarding, training programs, demonstrations, workshops, and enablement activities.
Create product documentation, onboarding materials, and customer education resources.
Measure adoption, customer satisfaction, and engagement to ensure successful implementation and sustained usage.

Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
Experience in Product Management, Program Management, Strategy, or related functions.
Experience owning product strategy, roadmap development, prioritization, and execution.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to make data-driven decisions.
Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, analytics, and business teams.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level presentations and documentation.

full_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. 
Introduction to the Team 
Our Technology Team partners with teams across Expedia Group to create innovative products, services, and tools to deliver high-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction. 
We’re hiring a hands-on high-performing individual contributor to own and evolve a core Vacation Rental KPI . You will be responsible for turning complex data into clear, actionable insights for senior leaders. 
You will lead analysis projects end-to-end—designing and building datasets, creating robust analytical products, and delivering high-impact dashboards and recommendations. You’ll follow team-wide visualization standards and use AI/LLM tools pragmatically to create efficiency and scale. 
In this role, you will: 
O wn a key KPI and its dashboard : Define, build, and maintain a stakeholder-facing dashboard that becomes the single source of truth for KPI health and performance. 
Lead end-to-end analytics projects (scoping, data engineering, analysis, visualization, delivery) that drive measurable improvements in supply, quality, and conversion. 
Build reliable, repeatable datasets and pipelines from multiple sources using SQL and scripting ( Python/R ), with strong attention to performance and data quality. 
Create clear, persuasive visualizations and interactive dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Plotly, ggplot ) for both technical and non‑technical audiences, with a strong focus on storytelling and decision support. 
High visibility : Own a core VR KPI and dashboard used by senior leaders to steer the VR business. 
Direct, measurable impact : Your insights and recommendations will shape how we grow and optimize Vacation Rental supply. 
Ownership and leadership : Lead analytics workstreams end-to-end, from problem framing to final recommendations and follow-through. 
Modern toolkit : Work in a collaborative environment that embraces modern analytics, engineering, and AI tools to increase impact and scale. 
Automate recurring reports and monitoring , including data-quality checks and alerting, to ensure stakeholders always have trusted, up-to-date views on key metrics. 
Introduce and operationalize AI/LLM tools (e.g., for code generation, documentation, insight summarization, report automation) where they meaningfully increase productivity and scale. 
Collaborate with product, marketing, operations, and data science teams to frame questions, translate business problems into analytical workstreams, and present trade-offs and recommendations. 
Produce reproducible code and documentation , sharing artifacts via Git, Confluence , and team knowledge bases. 
Apply statistical methods and intermediate ML approaches (e.g., regression, classification, clustering) when appropriate; partner with central Data Science to validate and scale models. 
Design and analyze measurement strategies and experiments (A/B tests, pre/post analyses, causal impact, multivariate tests) for initiatives affecting VR inventory. 
Experience & Qualifications: 
Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering , or related field (Master’s is a plus), or equivalent practical experience. 
2–3 years in a comparable analytics or data science role (with relevant degree), or 4+ years of directly relevant industry experience. 
Advanced SQL (joins, window functions, performance tuning). 
Strong proficiency in Python or R for data wrangling, analysis, and automation. 
Experience combining multiple data sources and building repeatable, well-documented datasets . 
Visualization & storytelling: Solid experience designing and maintaining dashboards in Tableau or similar BI tools . 
Ability to translate complex analyses and metrics into simple, intuitive visuals and narratives for non-technical stakeholders. 
Statistics & experimentation: Working knowledge of applied statistics and basic ML (e.g., AB testing, statistical significance, regression, pre/post and causal impact analyses). 
Data engineering mindset: Familiarity with data modeling , pipeline design, and best practices for performance, reliability, and data quality . 
Communication & stakeholder management: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to listen, gather requirements , and proactively manage expectations. 
Comfortable presenting findings and recommendations to senior and executive stakeholders . 
Ways of working: Critical thinker with strong business acumen and a bias for action. 
Collaborative mindset and willingness to coach junior colleagues and share best practices. 
Familiarity with AI/LLM tools and enthusiasm for using them to automate workflows, speed analyses, and scale insight delivery. 
Accommodation requests 
Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation .

About Expedia Group 
Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Important notice 
Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .

Equal Opportunity

Deploy scalable AI services using cloud-native architectures 
5. Semantic Layer & Business Alignment 
Integrate AI systems with governed semantic layers and metadata 
Ensure outputs align with defined KPIs, business rules, and data standards 
Translate business questions into reusable AI-powered analytics services

Implement logging, performance tracking, and reliability checks 
Ensure secure, privacy-safe AI usage aligned with enterprise policies 
Support CI/CD, testing, and robust deployment practices

4–8 years of experience in AI/Data Engineering or Applied AI systems 
Strong programming skills in Python 
Strong SQL and data modeling experience ( Snowflake preferred ) 
AI / LLM & Prompt Engineering

Strong software engineering practices (CI/CD, testing, version control)

At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day.

Job Title: Azure Cloud Solution Architect (DBA & Data Migration)
Location: Hyderabad, Telangana (Onsite)
Job Type: Full-time
Experience: 15+ Years
Full Job Description
We are seeking an experienced Azure Cloud Solution Architect (DBA & Data Migration) with 15+ years of expertise in enterprise database architecture, cloud migration, and modernization. The ideal candidate will have extensive hands-on experience migrating databases from on-premises environments to Microsoft Azure while ensuring high availability, security, scalability, and performance.
This role requires strong technical leadership in database architecture, migration strategy, performance tuning, Azure cloud technologies, and DevOps practices.
Key Responsibilities
Lead enterprise-scale database migration projects from on-premises environments to Microsoft Azure.
Design and implement migration strategies for Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB databases.
Plan and execute zero or low-downtime database migrations with validation and reconciliation.
Design High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), backup, and recovery solutions.
Perform database capacity planning, performance tuning, and scalability optimization.
Execute schema conversion, dependency analysis, and compatibility remediation.
Optimize migrated workloads for cost, reliability, and performance.
Troubleshoot complex database performance issues and production incidents.
Collaborate with Architecture, DevOps, Infrastructure, and Application teams throughout migration projects.
Provide technical leadership and best practices for database modernization initiatives.
Support enterprise cloud transformation and database modernization programs.
Required Skills
15+ years of experience in Database Administration, Database Architecture, and Cloud Migration.
Strong expertise in Microsoft Azure Cloud Platform.
Hands-on experience migrating databases from on-premises to Azure Cloud.
Expertise in Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB.
Strong understanding of High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), backup, and recovery strategies.
Experience with database performance tuning and optimization.
Hands-on experience with schema conversion and migration execution.
Strong troubleshooting and production support experience.
Ability to manage complex multi-platform database migration projects.
Experience working with DevOps teams and modern cloud architecture.
Excellent communication, analytical, and leadership skills.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF) for ETL/ELT pipelines.
Knowledge of Self-hosted Integration Runtime (SHIR).
Experience with SSIS migration to Azure.
Hands-on experience with Terraform for infrastructure provisioning.
Knowledge of GitHub Actions and CI/CD pipelines.
Understanding of cloud-native integration patterns.
Exposure to multi-cloud environments (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Microsoft Azure Certifications are highly preferred.
Experience leading enterprise-scale cloud migration and modernization initiatives.
Work Location: In person
